three.min.js and OrbitControls.js are three.js r128 (https://threejs.org), MIT licence,
copyright (c) 2010-2021 three.js authors. They are copied unchanged from the npm
package three@0.128.0 (build/three.min.js and examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js)
and are used only by static/anatomy.js, the platform's 3D anatomy simulator.

GLTFLoader.js is also three.js r128 (examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js, MIT), copied unchanged; it loads the
detailed anatomy models stored in static/models/ (served from this server, nothing is fetched from other sites).
